scope: Assets excluded from Git that must be published to independent media storage before retiring Sanity CDN. Ordinary website assets under public/static/website-media are included in Git and do not need separate shipping.
instructions: Upload each localOriginal to the suggestedStorageKey on the chosen media store. If this local backup is unavailable, download currentUrl and verify sha256.
Set Content-Type to contentType; some source filenames end in .webp but contain PNG bytes. Preserve the original bytes.
Verify file sizes and SHA-256 values after transfer.
Replace each currentUrl in the listed references with the deployed media URL and verify the relevant pages and downloads.
Current CDN links are still in use. Keep them working until the replacement URLs are verified.
